{"fixed_xml":"<ITEM>In dem Brandmüllerischen Buchladen wird ein <BIBL><TITLE>Project von Hiorini klugen und verständigen Haus-Patter, wie auch avelichem Land-Leben</TITLE>, welches durch Sub-scriptionen in <VOLUME>2. Folianten</VOLUME> à <PRIZE>6. fl.</PRIZE> gedrucket wird</BIBL>. Ferner ist allda neu fertig worden: <BIBL><AUTHOR>Lutheri</AUTHOR> <TITLE>Bibel</TITLE> mit Figuren in <FORMAT>fol.</FORMAT></BIBL>; Item, des Herrn Abbts <BIBL><AUTHOR>Fleury</AUTHOR> <TITLE>Kirchen-Historien</TITLE> <FORMAT>8vo.</FORMAT> aus dem frantzösischen ubersetzt</BIBL>; Item, <BIBL><TITLE>die gantze Pflicht des Menschen</TITLE> <FORMAT>8vo.</FORMAT> aus dem Englischen ubersetzt</BIBL></ITEM>","number_of_corrections":8,"explanation":"
1. Replaced Unicode escape sequences with proper characters throughout: √ú → ü (Brandmüllerischen), √º → ü (neu), √§ → ä (verständigen), √ü → ß (Haus), √† → à (price symbol), √∂ → ö (frantzösischen).
2. Removed the misplaced `<AUTHOR>Hiorini</AUTHOR>` tag from inside the `<TITLE>` element — "Hiorini" appears to be part of the title text (e.g. "Project von Hiorini klugen und verständigen Haus-Patter..."), so it was folded back into the `<TITLE>` content.
3. Removed the erroneous duplicate/stray closing `</TITLE>` tag that appeared after "Land-Leben" (there was already a `<TITLE>` open tag, and a second `</TITLE>` was orphaned).
4. Fixed "Sub. scriptionen" (broken word with period) → "Sub-scriptionen".
5. Wrapped the second bibliographic entry (Fleury's Kirchen-Historien) in a `<BIBL>` tag, which was missing — `<AUTHOR>Fleury</AUTHOR>`, `<TITLE>Kirchen-Historien</TITLE>`, and `<FORMAT>8vo.</FORMAT>` were floating outside any `<BIBL>` container.
"}
